**Chinese name:** 深圳市紫光同创电子股份有限公司 (Zǐguāng Tóngchuàng)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
The last big unlisted domestic FPGA asset and the volume player in comms-side programmable logic; 2025 net loss narrowed to ¥108m (from ¥344m). STAR listing tutoring (CICC) filed April 2025 — fifth progress update published August 2026, still pre-acceptance — making it a near-term test of FPGA valuations after Fudan Micro's scarcity-driven rally.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Communication/industrial FPGAs and design software.

## Key Facts

| | |
|---|---|
| **Category** | Fabless |
| **Founded** | 2013 |
| **Location** | Shenzhen, Guangdong |
| **Product Focus** | FPGA: Logos-2/Titan-2/Kosmo-2 lines + in-house EDA — comms, industrial, consumer |
| **Node Sophistication** | Mid-range FPGA nodes (28nm-class mainstream in domestic comms); high-end FinFET line not yet demonstrated vs Fudan/Anlogic |
| **Entity List** | No |
